title: The retro and the roadmap read the window
body:
Outcome: the lead's handoff prints the window for the session's span, computed from the main checkout, and the roadmap rerank cites it instead of dollars per PR.
Why: a measure with no consumer was deleted here three times (`02` section I, the survival rule).
Proof: a test of the handoff generator sees the window block; `t-bc4772y` closes on it.
Scope: `src/state/retro.ts`, `docs/program/roadmap.md`, `docs/program/lead-rules.md`.
Order: B1, B2, B3; then the two measurements B6 and B7; B4 when the operator adds the line; B5 last.
Order: after B1 and A6.
Carries: adr-draft-window-unit.md and adr-draft-0016-pull-request-is-the-delivery-record.md; closes t-bc4772y.
